supersedes: the 2026-07-14 recording, taken BEFORE `source_span` became derived
note: ★ THE FLOOR AFTER THE FIX THE INSTRUMENT FOUND. The published, hand-produced baseline claimed 9/11 with 'Zero junk'. The instrument measured 7/11 with TWO forbidden names, and then showed WHY: 9 of 13 failing runs were a bad `source_span`. `apply` now DERIVES the span from the (already-verbatim) quote, and the model is no longer asked to count lines. RESULT: 7/11 -> 10/11, and the CLEAN subset -- the only number that measures the SKILL rather than the prompt's memory of the answer -- went 2/3 -> 3/3. THREE fixtures improved, ZERO regressed, and the forbidden count did NOT rise: no recall was bought with junk.

diagnosis.headline: ★ THE MECHANICAL NOISE IS GONE, AND THE REAL RECALL GAP NOW STANDS ALONE. Before the fix the failure census was 9 span / 1 recall -- the recall gap DF-064-4 is named for was buried under arithmetic the model cannot do. It is now the ONLY thing left.
diagnosis.what_remains: Fixture 09 alone: the model extracts «Падёж» under its BARE name (item 1 on that fixture's forbidden list) and drops «Грамматический падеж». THIS is DF-064-4's original diagnosis -- and it is now ISOLATED and MEASURABLE, which it never was before. Note that SKILL.md ALREADY carries fixture 09's exact expected names plus an explicit 'And extract BOTH', and the model fails anyway: prompt text is not the lever. The next task must find a MECHANICAL one, and it must be measured on THIS instrument.
